1hc1x3s.q: The panel shown indicates the proximity of a tight bend
1hc1x3s.why: The panel numbers the hairpin bends (tornanti) in a series; this one marks the first, so a tight bend is close.

1cgsrb2.q: The panel shown indicates the progressive number of a dangerous bend
1cgsrb2.why: The panel gives the sequential number of the hairpin bend, a dangerous tight curve within a series.

2502dj.q: The panel shown indicates the first of a series of hairpin bends (tight-radius curves)
2502dj.why: The number 1 on the panel marks the first hairpin bend (tornante) in a series of tight curves.

hwb7w9.q: The panel shown, in a series of hairpin bends, indicates the progressive number of the bend
hwb7w9.why: In a series of hairpin bends the panel shows the bend's order number, here the first.

1mbm8kf.q: The panel shown indicates a roundabout zone
1mbm8kf.why: The panel numbers a hairpin bend (tornante) in a series; it has nothing to do with roundabouts.

o0jb1g.q: The panel shown indicates that in one kilometre we will find a hairpin bend
o0jb1g.why: The number on the panel is the bend's order number in the series, not a distance in kilometres.

3tdm3t.q: The panel shown indicates the kilometres to travel in order to turn back
3tdm3t.why: The panel numbers hairpin bends; it gives no distances and says nothing about turning back.

1mt32nd.q: The panel shown indicates the number of intersections passed
1mt32nd.why: The number shows which hairpin bend this is in the sequence, not how many intersections have been passed.

6gfk19.q: The panel shown indicates how many kilometres away the next hairpin bend is
6gfk19.why: The panel shows the order number of the hairpin bend, not the distance to the next one.

23zsk6.q: The panel shown indicates the number of the overpass
23zsk6.why: The panel numbers hairpin bends in a series; it does not identify overpasses (cavalcavia).

1kha2az.q: The sign shown indicates the recommended direction for trucks with a maximum laden mass exceeding 3.5 tonnes
1kha2az.why: This temporary detour sign tells trucks over 3.5 tonnes laden mass to take the direction shown by the arrow.

1j1si50.q: The sign shown indicates the category of vehicles for which the turn is recommended
1j1si50.why: The truck symbol shows the vehicle category for which the turn shown by the arrow is recommended.

1v1pxkw.q: The sign shown is installed at the point of the recommended detour for trucks exceeding 3.5 tonnes
1v1pxkw.why: The sign is placed exactly where trucks over 3.5 tonnes should take the recommended detour.

132sm24.q: The sign shown may be preceded by an advance warning sign
132sm24.why: Like many temporary signs, it can be preceded by an advance warning sign.

60c7e2.q: The sign shown is located near an intersection that precedes a roadworks site
60c7e2.why: This yellow temporary sign is placed near an intersection ahead of a roadworks site (cantiere stradale).

1k8avs2.q: The sign shown indicates that turning left is prohibited
1k8avs2.why: The arrow shows a recommended direction for trucks, not a prohibition, and it points right.

6ptds7.q: The sign shown indicates a parking area for trucks
6ptds7.why: The sign recommends a detour for trucks; it does not mark any parking area.

jb1d96.q: The sign shown indicates the direction to follow to reach a landfill
jb1d96.why: The sign shows the recommended detour for trucks, not the way to a landfill.

1z13ioz.q: The sign shown indicates a one-way road on the right, reserved only for trucks
1z13ioz.why: The sign recommends that trucks turn right; it does not create a one-way road reserved for them.

12eokjt.q: The sign shown obliges trucks to turn right
12eokjt.why: The direction is only recommended for heavy trucks; it is not a mandatory turn.

rro6cj.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of roadworks
rro6cj.why: This warning sign (lavori) gives advance notice of roadworks ahead.

1x7j3e8.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of work sites
1x7j3e8.why: The roadworks warning sign announces the presence of work sites on the road.

1fkgdqw.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of possible temporary deposits of materials or machinery
1fkgdqw.why: The sign also warns that materials or machinery may be temporarily stored there.

df893f.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of the possible presence of workers on or near the carriageway
df893f.why: The sign warns that workers may be on or beside the carriageway (carreggiata).

1f9abp4.q: The sign shown may be supplemented by a panel indicating the length of the work site
1f9abp4.why: A supplementary panel may show how long the work site is.

159b28h.q: The sign shown requires giving way to vehicles leaving the work site
159b28h.why: It is a warning sign; it does not create any duty to give way to vehicles leaving the work site.

1rn6r8o.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of the obligation to give way to vehicles coming from the opposite direction
1rn6r8o.why: It warns of roadworks, not of a duty to give way to oncoming vehicles.

1u0yqht.q: The sign shown requires reversing the direction of travel during workers' working hours
1u0yqht.why: The sign warns of roadworks and does not require any change or reversal of direction.

1285iaw.q: The sign shown requires giving way to site workers
1285iaw.why: It only warns of the hazard of roadworks; it creates no priority duty towards workers.

pl7yvo.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of alternating one-way traffic
pl7yvo.why: The sign warns of roadworks; alternating one-way traffic has its own separate signs.

11bcq6r.q: The barrier shown marks an area occupied by a road work site
11bcq6r.why: The red-and-white striped barrier marks an area taken up by a road work site.

1bnrjqr.q: The barrier shown delimits an area where roadworks are taking place
1bnrjqr.why: The barrier fences off the area where road works are in progress.

pj3r4u.q: The barrier shown is placed at the edges of a road work site
pj3r4u.why: Barriers are placed along the edges of the work site to delimit it.

1ie9s9e.q: The barrier shown may be used at level crossings when the gates are faulty
1ie9s9e.why: The barrier can stand in for broken gates at a level crossing (passaggio a livello).

1tg1507.q: The barrier shown may be supplemented by a fixed red light lantern in poor visibility
1tg1507.why: In poor visibility it may be supplemented by a lantern showing a steady red light.

188pihe.q: The barrier shown is found at the entrance of a garage
188pihe.why: It is a temporary work-site or closure barrier, not a garage device.

c8exgj.q: The barrier shown marks a parking area reserved for road work vehicles
c8exgj.why: The barrier delimits a work site or closed area; it does not mark reserved parking.

i4ns75.q: The barrier shown is found at motorway toll booths to delimit the lanes
i4ns75.why: It is not used to separate toll lanes; it delimits work sites or temporary closures.

liz8z.q: The barrier shown signals a dangerous bend
liz8z.why: Dangerous bends are signalled by warning signs or delineators, not by this barrier.

1vrcm3s.q: The barriers signal a cycle path
1vrcm3s.why: Red-and-white striped barriers mark work sites or closures, not cycle paths.

1dy4k9g.q: The cone shown may delimit short-duration work zones
1dy4k9g.why: Cones are used to mark off short-term work zones.

6oiud9.q: The cone shown may be used to signal temporary diversions
6oiud9.why: Cones may mark temporary traffic diversions.

1qgeay0.q: The cone shown may be used to indicate areas affected by accidents
1qgeay0.why: Cones may mark off areas where an accident has occurred.

d292rw.q: The cone shown may indicate a temporary separation of the directions of travel
d292rw.why: Cones may temporarily separate opposing directions of travel.

1uuoyi5.q: The cone shown is used to indicate a reserved parking space
1uuoyi5.why: The cone marks works or temporary situations; it does not reserve parking spaces.

18kyah9.q: The cone shown may be used for roadworks lasting more than 10 days
18kyah9.why: Cones are allowed only for works lasting no more than 10 days.

dsminn.q: The cone shown is used on roads where heavy snowfall occurs
dsminn.why: Roads with heavy snowfall use snow marker posts (paletti), not cones.

4dqyt1.q: The cone shown separates the carriageway from the cycle path
4dqyt1.why: The cone is a temporary device and does not separate the carriageway from a cycle path.

annotu.q: The cone shown indicates an obstacle placed outside the carriageway
annotu.why: The cone marks temporary situations on the carriageway, not obstacles outside it.

764iho.q: The sign shown may be placed on road work vehicles, stationary or moving slowly
764iho.why: The sign may be fitted to road work vehicles that are stopped or moving slowly.

ocdc1u.q: The sign shown indicates the side from which the vehicle it is placed on must be overtaken
ocdc1u.why: The arrow shows the side on which the vehicle carrying the sign must be passed.

1fh7dom.q: The sign shown may be placed on road maintenance vehicles stopped on the carriageway
1fh7dom.why: It may be applied to road maintenance vehicles standing on the carriageway.

78xgn4.q: The sign shown may be placed on some road work vehicles travelling at low speed
78xgn4.why: It may be fitted to certain road work vehicles moving at low speed.

yyw4wl.q: The sign shown invites drivers to reduce speed because of the possible presence of stationary or slow-moving vehicles
yyw4wl.why: It tells drivers to slow down because stopped or slow-moving vehicles may be present.

rwb3ih.q: The sign shown indicates to overtake the obstacle on the left
rwb3ih.why: The arrow points down to the right, so the vehicle must be passed on the right.

1rztmw3.q: The sign shown indicates to turn right immediately
1rztmw3.why: The sign shows which side to pass the vehicle on, not an immediate turn.

1819wr4.q: The sign shown indicates that the right lane is closed for road maintenance
1819wr4.why: It does not signal a lane closure; it shows the side for passing a work vehicle.

176v5ti.q: The sign shown obliges drivers to stop on the right
176v5ti.why: It does not require stopping; it only shows which side to pass the vehicle on.

1o9zkpq.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of a mobile work site with a narrowing on the left
1o9zkpq.why: The sign warns of a mobile work site with a narrowing on the left, where the lane closes.

17v177y.q: The sign shown may be installed on a vehicle to give advance warning of a road work site
17v177y.why: It can be mounted on a vehicle to warn of a mobile road work site.

z9nwbq.q: The sign shown indicates the lanes available for traffic
z9nwbq.why: The black arrows show the lanes still open; the red band marks the closed one.

183bf1d.q: The sign shown indicates a reduction from three to two lanes
183bf1d.why: The sign shows three lanes reduced to two by closing a side lane.

q0vefz.q: The sign shown may be completed with flashing yellow lights
q0vefz.why: The sign may be fitted with flashing yellow lights.

nwyjx2.q: The sign shown indicates how many vehicles can pass at the same time
nwyjx2.why: It shows the lane layout at a narrowing, not how many vehicles may pass together.

otn4vg.q: The sign shown indicates a lay-by on the left side
otn4vg.why: The sign warns of a lane closure, not a lay-by (piazzola di sosta).

yqdeu2.q: The sign shown tells vehicles with an actual mass exceeding 7 tonnes heading for Lucca to change road
yqdeu2.why: The sign tells vehicles over 7 tonnes heading for Lucca to take the alternative route.

19lu7zq.q: The sign shown allows trucks with a laden mass below 7 tonnes to continue straight ahead
19lu7zq.why: The 7 t limit only affects heavier vehicles; those under 7 t may continue straight.

1awovvx.q: The sign shown does not allow vehicles with an actual mass exceeding 7 tonnes heading for Lucca to continue straight ahead
1awovvx.why: Vehicles over 7 tonnes heading for Lucca must follow the detour and cannot go straight.

lysprh.q: The sign shown indicates a transit limitation on a stretch of road for vehicles with an actual mass exceeding 7 tonnes
lysprh.why: The sign shows a transit restriction on a road section for vehicles over 7 tonnes.

6i5hjo.q: The sign shown is placed near an intersection that precedes a road work site
6i5hjo.why: It is placed near an intersection ahead of the work site, where the detour begins.

1ame1nh.q: The sign shown is one of the temporary signs for road work sites
1ame1nh.why: It is a temporary yellow-background sign used for road work sites.

117n3ya.q: The sign shown indicates, for all vehicles, that it is not possible to continue straight to Lucca
117n3ya.why: The restriction applies only to vehicles over 7 tonnes; all others can continue straight to Lucca.

3g4osc.q: The sign shown obliges all vehicles to turn right at the next fork
3g4osc.why: The sign is not a mandatory order and does not apply to all vehicles, only those over 7 tonnes.

c5dl9x.q: The sign shown prohibits overtaking for motor vehicles with a total mass exceeding 7 tonnes
c5dl9x.why: The sign concerns going straight versus a detour, not a no-overtaking rule.

ikwm5y.q: The sign shown prohibits transit for vehicles exceeding 7 metres in length
ikwm5y.why: The 7 t figure is a mass in tonnes, not a length of 7 metres.

koq0cs.q: The sign shown indicates the closure of the right lane due to roadworks
koq0cs.why: The red band on the right marks the closure of the right lane due to roadworks.

gra6ad.q: The sign shown indicates a reduction from two lanes to one
gra6ad.why: The sign shows two lanes narrowing to one.

1tf0mlf.q: The sign shown is placed near a road work site
1tf0mlf.why: It is placed near the road work site that causes the lane closure.

1wwwves.q: The sign shown may be completed with a panel indicating the distance from the lane closure point
1wwwves.why: A supplementary panel may show the distance to the point where the lane closes.

mol2d4.q: The sign shown indicates a narrowing of the carriageway due to roadworks
mol2d4.why: The sign shows the carriageway narrowing because of roadworks.

ygm7b0.q: The sign shown indicates the possibility of overtaking on the right
ygm7b0.why: The sign warns of a lane closure; it does not allow overtaking on the right.

yylat4.q: The sign shown announces an interchange that allows a U-turn
yylat4.why: It has nothing to do with interchanges or U-turns; it signals a lane closed for works.

75a9zx.q: The sign shown is located near an intersection
75a9zx.why: The sign is placed near a work site, not near an intersection.

lxdm35.q: The sign shown indicates a bus stop bay
lxdm35.why: The sign indicates a lane closure, not a bus bay.

1szbris.q: The sign shown indicates the closure of the lane for slow vehicles
1szbris.why: The closed lane is the right lane because of works, not a slow-vehicle lane.

gvna28.q: The sign shown obliges drivers to give way to vehicles coming from the right
gvna28.why: The sign informs of a narrowing and does not require giving way to vehicles from the right.

8xy815.q: The sign shown, placed where roadworks are present, indicates to the vehicle categories which lanes they may occupy
8xy815.why: At work sites the sign tells each vehicle category which lanes it may use.

xp7d8p.q: The sign shown is used to indicate lane use
xp7d8p.why: This lane-assignment sign indicates how the lanes are to be used.

1y2jvjt.q: The sign shown indicates to vehicles which lanes they must travel in
1y2jvjt.why: The sign tells vehicles which lanes they must travel in.

92wpno.q: The sign shown indicates that trucks with a total mass exceeding 3.5 tonnes may use only the right lane
92wpno.why: The truck symbol appears only over the right lane, so vehicles over 3.5 tonnes may use only that lane.

xrpdj2.q: The sign shown indicates the approach of a motorway toll booth
xrpdj2.why: This panel assigns lanes to vehicle types, with trucks kept to the right lane, usually at roadworks. It does not announce a toll booth (casello).

1km4g76.q: The sign shown requires trucks to travel in parallel lines
1km4g76.why: The panel assigns lanes by vehicle type: trucks must use the right lane, cars the other lanes. It does not order parallel-file driving.

h7gm3l.q: The sign shown indicates that trucks must only overtake on the right
h7gm3l.why: The panel shows which lane trucks must use, the right one. It says nothing about overtaking on the right, which stays prohibited except in cases the Code allows.

mmfjef.q: The sign shown prohibits motorcycles from using the left lane
mmfjef.why: The panel assigns lanes: trucks stay on the right, other lanes are for cars. It contains no ban on motorcycles.

1ky13ig.q: The delineators shown are used along the sides of the carriageway on one-way roads
1ky13ig.why: Delineators with yellow reflectors (delineatori) are placed at the edge of one-way carriageways, on the left side.

1scx3fg.q: The delineators shown are complementary signs
1scx3fg.why: Margin delineators (delineatori) belong to the complementary signs (segnali complementari), together with cones, barriers and posts.

42zzeg.q: The delineators shown are placed at the edges of a one-way road or carriageway
42zzeg.why: The yellow reflectors mark the edge of a one-way road or carriageway.

dl1w4o.q: The delineators shown serve to show the course of the road more clearly
dl1w4o.why: Margin delineators make the shape of the road easier to see, especially in poor visibility.

18p26md.q: The delineators shown are placed on a two-way road
18p26md.why: Yellow delineators are for one-way roads. Two-way roads use white and red ones.

1lqhz6i.q: The delineators shown are found before a pedestrian crossing
1lqhz6i.why: They are edge delineators for one-way carriageways and have nothing to do with pedestrian crossings (attraversamenti pedonali).

1ru06ri.q: The delineators shown are placed in the middle of the carriageway
1ru06ri.why: Edge delineators stand at the sides of the carriageway, not in the middle.

184iabz.q: The delineators shown divide the carriageway into lanes
184iabz.why: They mark the road edge. Dividing lanes is the job of road markings (segnaletica orizzontale).

19wih3p.q: The delineators shown are placed to indicate a reserved parking area
19wih3p.why: They mark the edge of a one-way carriageway, not reserved parking areas.

p6d47u.q: The delineators shown are visible only at night
p6d47u.why: They are also visible by day and are especially helpful in poor visibility, not only at night.

1i4vrn2.q: The delineators shown are mainly useful in conditions of poor visibility
1i4vrn2.why: Edge delineators help drivers follow the road edge, especially in fog, rain or darkness.

d8bhiq.q: The delineators shown are complementary signs
d8bhiq.why: Edge delineators (delineatori) are complementary signs (segnali complementari).

eaoz4b.q: The delineators shown are placed at the edges of a two-way road
eaoz4b.why: White and red delineators are used at the edges of two-way roads: white on the right, red on the left.

9m8706.q: The delineators shown serve to show the course of the road more clearly
9m8706.why: They highlight the road edges and so show the course of the road, especially in poor visibility.

s6fere.q: The delineators shown are useful only at night
s6fere.why: They help in any poor visibility, including daytime fog or rain, not only at night.

1jm89n2.q: The delineators shown are placed at least 100 metres from one another
1jm89n2.why: Delineators are placed much closer together; there is no 100-metre minimum spacing. Close spacing helps guide the eye along the road.

1gamycc.q: The delineators shown are placed in the middle of the carriageway
1gamycc.why: They are placed at the sides of the carriageway, not in the centre.

1jkt5ph.q: The delineators shown divide the carriageway into lanes
1jkt5ph.why: They do not divide lanes; they mark the road edge. Lanes are separated by road markings (segnaletica orizzontale).

1lr8fnm.q: The delineators shown are placed at the sides of the carriageway on one-way roads
1lr8fnm.why: White and red reflectors are for two-way roads. One-way roads use yellow ones.

u0nv3u.q: The delineator shown is placed at the sides of one-way tunnels
u0nv3u.why: The delineator with a yellow panel is placed along the sides of one-way tunnels (gallerie).

bupq6y.q: The delineator shown is a complementary sign placed in one-way tunnels
bupq6y.why: It is a complementary sign (segnale complementare), a delineator used in one-way tunnels.

1q2e5jz.q: The delineator shown can also be found highlighting diversions or narrowings of the carriageway
1q2e5jz.why: It can also be used to highlight diversions or narrowings (strettoie) of the carriageway.

37jsf3.q: The delineator shown is a complementary sign
37jsf3.why: Delineators belong to the complementary signs (segnali complementari).

phnjkt.q: The delineator shown is used to indicate a one-way junction
phnjkt.why: It does not mark junctions. It is a delineator used along one-way tunnels or at diversions and narrowings.

47iz39.q: The delineator shown indicates a closed road
47iz39.why: It does not mean the road is closed. It is an edge delineator, used for example in one-way tunnels.

42tv3z.q: The delineator shown is placed in the middle of the carriageway to indicate an obstacle
42tv3z.why: It stands at the sides, not in the middle. Obstacles on the carriageway are marked by other devices.

1sl0jnh.q: The delineator shown divides the carriageway into lanes
1sl0jnh.why: It does not divide lanes; it marks the edge. Lanes are divided by road markings.

16t2b1k.q: The delineator shown is a distance panel placed near a level crossing
16t2b1k.why: Level-crossing distance panels (pannelli distanziometrici) are different, with red diagonal bars. This is a delineator.

gsza4e.q: The delineator shown has its own light
gsza4e.why: It is a passive, reflective delineator and has no light of its own.

95qk2l.q: The delineator shown is placed at the sides of the carriageway on mountain roads subject to snowfall
95qk2l.why: The yellow and black post is placed at the sides of snowy mountain roads to show the carriageway edges.

1gw3d2a.q: The delineator shown is a complementary sign
1gw3d2a.why: This marker post (paletto di delimitazione) is a complementary sign (segnale complementare).

1bg8z1g.q: The delineator shown is placed at the sides of the carriageway on mountain roads
1bg8z1g.why: The post is placed at the sides of the carriageway on mountain roads prone to snow.

qgkvu1.q: The delineator shown is used to make the edges of the carriageway of a snow-covered road more visible
qgkvu1.why: It keeps the carriageway edges visible when snow covers the road.

d4cjlb.q: The delineator shown is placed at the bus stop
d4cjlb.why: It does not mark bus stops (fermate); it is a post for snowy mountain roads.

1ysvz4n.q: The delineator shown is placed in the middle of the carriageway
1ysvz4n.why: It is placed at the sides to show the carriageway edges, not in the middle.

5ju2n4.q: The delineator shown is found near a pedestrian crossing
5ju2n4.why: It is not tied to pedestrian crossings; it marks the edges of snowy mountain roads.

12i47fv.q: The delineator shown is used as an anchoring post for parking bicycles
12i47fv.why: It is a road complementary sign, not a rack for locking bicycles.

1jdosp1.q: The delineator shown is used on roads without side barriers (guardrails)
1jdosp1.why: Its use does not depend on missing guardrails; it marks the edges of mountain roads subject to snow.

tbgzla.q: The delineator shown indicates a parking ban
tbgzla.why: It does not indicate a parking ban (divieto di sosta); it marks the edges of a snowy road.

3suo2s.q: The delineator shown is placed on tight curves with poor visibility
3suo2s.why: The curve delineator is placed on tight curves with limited visibility to guide the driver.

1ebmtlx.q: The delineator shown is normally found after the DANGEROUS CURVE TO THE LEFT sign
1ebmtlx.why: It normally follows the dangerous curve to the left warning sign; the arrows point in the direction of the bend.

y9h660.q: The delineator shown, if white and red, indicates a temporary curve to the left
y9h660.why: In white and red it marks a temporary curve (curva provvisoria); the left-pointing arrows show a left bend.

n0dmsw.q: The delineator shown is used to signal a dangerous curve
n0dmsw.why: It signals a dangerous curve, with the arrows showing its direction.

9j6she.q: The delineator shown invites the driver to be careful when negotiating a curve
9j6she.why: It tells the driver to take care in the curve and shows which way it bends.

1qz7ud7.q: The delineator shown indicates a road worksite
1qz7ud7.why: It marks a dangerous curve, not a road worksite (cantiere stradale).

1qzc1yr.q: The delineator shown signals a road with climbs and descents
1qzc1yr.why: It signals a curve, not gradients. Climbs and descents have their own warning signs.

1fgpepj.q: The delineator shown indicates obstacles protruding onto the carriageway
1fgpepj.why: It signals a dangerous curve. Obstacles are marked by other delineators.

1cmxzmg.q: The delineator shown signals a dangerous curve to the right
1cmxzmg.why: The arrows point left, so the curve bends left.

y4wk7j.q: The delineator shown indicates that one is close to a level crossing
y4wk7j.why: It has nothing to do with level crossings (passaggi a livello), which have their own signs. It marks a dangerous curve.

cz4cm7.q: The delineator shown is placed only on main extra-urban roads
cz4cm7.why: It is not limited to main extra-urban roads; it can be used on any road with dangerous curves.

ho1mdi.q: The delineator shown indicates to turn right or left
ho1mdi.why: The double-arrow delineator at a T-junction means the driver must turn right or left.

1gu730m.q: The delineator shown has arrow tips that point out the possible directions
1gu730m.why: The arrow tips show the allowed directions: right and left.

1na8ug4.q: The delineator shown is installed at a T-shaped junction
1na8ug4.why: It is installed at a T-junction (incrocio a T), where the road ends and only turns are possible.

1yeu0bk.q: The delineator shown is placed at a junction where it is not possible to go straight on
1yeu0bk.why: Placed facing the end of the road, it shows you cannot continue straight on.

129nptf.q: The delineator shown indicates a level crossing
129nptf.why: It marks a T-junction, not a level crossing (passaggio a livello).

1m8h2bn.q: The delineator shown indicates a movable bridge
1m8h2bn.why: It has nothing to do with movable bridges; its arrows direct turns at a T-junction.

12ffr9r.q: The delineator shown indicates a road closed for roadworks
12ffr9r.why: It signals a T-junction where going straight is impossible, not a closure for roadworks.

yl7hku.q: The delineator shown indicates an increase in the number of lanes of the road
yl7hku.why: The arrows show two turning directions, not extra lanes.

h06en4.q: The delineator shown indicates a curve on a one-way road
h06en4.why: It does not mark a curve; it marks a T-junction with a right or left turn.

1piceg9.q: The delineator shown indicates the entrance to a tunnel
1piceg9.why: It does not signal tunnels (gallerie); it marks a T-junction.

1hws5dr.q: The delineator shown is placed in a series of several elements to highlight a dangerous curve
1hws5dr.why: Curve delineators are placed in a series to highlight a dangerous curve.

13elhkb.q: The delineator shown is a complementary sign
13elhkb.why: The curve delineator is a complementary sign (segnale complementare).

1r27kyb.q: The delineator shown indicates a dangerous curve to the right
1r27kyb.why: The arrow points right, so the dangerous curve bends right.

nchzqx.q: The delineator shown indicates a dangerous curve to the left
nchzqx.why: The arrow points right, so the curve bends right, not left.

1yidrnp.q: The delineator shown is located 150 metres before a curve
1yidrnp.why: The delineator stands in the curve itself, not 150 metres before it. There is no such fixed distance.

17kk9ee.q: The delineator shown is placed at the entrance of a tunnel
17kk9ee.why: It marks a dangerous curve, not a tunnel entrance.

1kd87rq.q: The delineator shown is used at level crossings when the barriers are faulty
1kd87rq.why: Other devices are used when level-crossing barriers are faulty. This one marks a dangerous curve.

bqbyio.q: The delineator shown is found only if the curve is on a one-way road
bqbyio.why: It is used on dangerous curves of any road, including two-way roads.

p1trmd.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of a traffic light system at a road worksite
p1trmd.why: The sign warns of an upcoming traffic light system (impianto semaforico), including temporary ones at roadworks.

1glpc6g.q: The sign shown can be found on both urban and extra-urban roads
1glpc6g.why: The traffic light warning sign can appear on both urban and extra-urban roads.

1hf79o1.q: The sign shown may be placed before a narrowing of the carriageway due to roadworks
1hf79o1.why: It may come before a lane narrowing at roadworks where traffic is controlled by a light.

11hpkm9.q: In the sign shown, the central disc is a flashing yellow light
11hpkm9.why: In this sign the central disc is a flashing yellow light.

1c5nq4a.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of a traffic light that regulates traffic on movable or swing bridges
1c5nq4a.why: The sign warns of traffic lights in general. Movable bridges have their own specific sign.

1li1htk.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of a STOP sign
1li1htk.why: The sign warns of a traffic light, not a STOP sign.

dht9wf.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of access to the boarding pier of ferries
dht9wf.why: It does not warn of ferry boarding piers (pontile d'imbarco); it warns of traffic lights.

5zxfrz.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of a railway crossing without barriers
5zxfrz.why: A level crossing without barriers has a different sign. This one warns of traffic lights.

1ary31v.q: The delineator shown is used to signal an obstacle
1ary31v.why: This obstacle delineator (delineatore di ostacolo) signals an obstacle; the arrow shows which side to pass.

tob4ox.q: The delineator shown is placed inside the carriageway, where there is an obstacle
tob4ox.why: It is placed inside the carriageway, at an obstacle.

1gm9kyv.q: The delineator shown is reflective, for better visibility at night
1gm9kyv.why: It is reflective (rifrangente), for better visibility at night.

1761j9v.q: The delineator shown can mark the start of a traffic island
1761j9v.why: It can mark the start of a traffic island (isola di traffico), showing which side to pass.

18u5z6b.q: The delineator shown has its own light
18u5z6b.why: It is only reflective and has no light of its own.

glqh79.q: The delineator shown is placed at the sides of the road
glqh79.why: It stands on the carriageway near the obstacle, not at the road sides.

1fhuse3.q: The delineator shown separates the carriageway from a cycle path
1fhuse3.why: It signals an obstacle; it is not used to separate the carriageway from a cycle path (pista ciclabile).

nk45b2.q: The delineator shown gives advance warning of a lane reserved for buses or taxis
nk45b2.why: It does not warn of reserved lanes; it signals an obstacle with a mandatory-passing arrow.

1hxck3y.q: The delineator shown is located outside the carriageway
1hxck3y.why: It is located inside the carriageway, at an obstacle.
